I got tired of using IMDb to rate movies and TV shows, and Letterboxd doesn’t support video games. So I built Tastemaker to let anyone curate their favorite movies, TV shows, and games all in one beautiful profile. You can use it to: → Rate and review your favorites → Create and share lists → Discover what to watch or play next Because of API limits, I’m launching this as a limited release for the first 100 profiles only. 📌 Claim your free profile now: https://mytastemaker.vercel.app/
